name: page alive, debug hook present
eval: typeof window.__N84 === 'object' && typeof window.__N84.set === 'function' ? 'hook ok, version ' + window.__N84.version : 'NO HOOK'

name: bridge live and initialState applied
eval: (function(){ var s = window.__N84.state(); var n = Object.keys(s.values || s).length; return (n > 100 ? 'params on page: ' + n : 'ONLY ' + n + ' PARAMS'); })()

name: set rank I cutoff to 0.3 through the page
native side has it (read back via hostParam echo path)
eval: Math.abs(window.__N84.get('a_lpf') - 0.3) < 1e-4 ? 'a_lpf = 0.3 on the page' : 'PAGE SAYS ' + window.__N84.get('a_lpf')

name: the patch name arrived and the values moved
eval: (function(){ var s = window.__N84.state(); return 'patch shows: ' + (s.patchName || s.patch || '?') + ' / a_lpf now ' + window.__N84.get('a_lpf').toFixed(3); })()

name: circuit selectors show what the patch says (CS STRINGS: both CS 12 dB)
play a note from the page
meter shows the voice and level
eval: (function(){ var m = window.__N84.meter(); return 'notes ' + JSON.stringify(m.notes) + ' out ' + (m.out||0).toFixed(3) + ' cut ' + JSON.stringify((m.cut||[]).map(function(x){return Math.round(x)})); })()

name: turn the tape on and check the reels are told
tape state on the page
eval: (function(){ var m = window.__N84.meter(); return 'tape_mode ' + window.__N84.get('tape_mode') + ' wow ' + (m.wow||0).toFixed(3); })()
